name: xstate-analyzer
description: Static analyzer for React / XState / Next.js projects: call graphs, XState state-machine diagrams, and external-call (HTTP/gRPC/GraphQL/DB) detection.

scripts.analyze:demo: tsx src/cli.ts analyze examples/demo -o examples/demo-out --format json,html,mermaid,dot,md
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run analyze:demo -- -q && npm run test:render
